segments.speaker: Jonas
segments.text: I signed up for the Lisbon marathon in December, training every morning now.

segments.speaker: Me
segments.text: That's ambitious! How far are you running?

segments.speaker: Jonas
segments.text: Thirty kilometers on Sundays. Also you have to read The Overstory, best book I read this year.

segments.speaker: Me
segments.text: Adding it to my list. Do you want the satay?

segments.speaker: Jonas
segments.text: No thanks, I'm allergic to peanuts, remember?
